# errors/from_progress_strategy_mismatch_latest_on_window — slice 4 deleted
# the {from_progress: <role>} discriminator; the cursor-namespace validator
# now catches templates that ref a cursor field time_window doesn't
# register (it only provides cursor.window_start / cursor.window_end, not
# the latest_event_timestamp-only cursor.last_timestamp).

! exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
stdout 'cursor field "last_timestamp" is not provided by the active pagination/progress strategy'

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"
auth:
  none: {}
requests:
  - method: POST
    path: /api/v1/search
    body:
      json:
        since: {ref: cursor.last_timestamp}
response:
  decode: json
  events_at: response.body.events
pagination:
  none: {}
progress:
  time_window:
    initial_offset: "24h"
